title: gen_statem: Protocol & Circuit Breaker State Machines
solutionExplanation: Implements a 3-state circuit breaker using gen_statem state_functions callback mode and state_timeout to self-heal from open to half_open automatically.

otpDocCards.description: Synchronously sends a request to a gen_statem process and waits for a reply.

mentalModelCheck.question: Why does a circuit breaker in the open state immediately reject client calls without invoking the provided action function?
mentalModelCheck.codeSnippet:
open({call, From}, {execute, _ActionFun}, Data) ->
    {keep_state, Data, [{reply, From, {error, circuit_open}}]}.

options.label: To protect failing downstream services from being overwhelmed by traffic, and to prevent client connection pools from exhausting on slow network timeouts.
options.explanation: Correct! Fast-failing immediately in 0ms sheds load from failing backend resources and keeps caller threads responsive.

options.label: Erlang disables network sockets when a process enters open state.
options.explanation: The state machine is purely application-level logic; sockets are not automatically modified.

options.label: Action functions can only be executed when the computer is connected to AC power.
options.explanation: Action functions are standard Erlang lambdas.
